cards.text: Jesus is at supper with His disciples, and He's just finished teaching them. Then He becomes troubled in spirit. He says, "Truly, truly, I tell you, one of you will betray Me."

cards.question: When Jesus says one of them will betray Him, the disciples know right away who He means.

cards.text: Nope. They look at one another, perplexed, like when the boss says "somebody in this room" and EVERYBODY checks everybody.
One of His disciples, the one whom Jesus loved, is reclining right at His side. And Simon Peter, another of Jesus' disciples, starts motioning to him.

cards.question: Simon Peter motions to the disciple reclining at Jesus' side. What does Peter want him to do?

answers.text: Ask Jesus which one He means
Get up and guard the door

cards.text: Peter's not waiting around, and I respect it. Me? I'd have just poked the guy with my mustache. So the disciple leans back against Jesus and asks, "Lord, who is it?"

cards.question: The disciple asks Jesus who will betray Him. How does Jesus say He'll show them?

answers.text: He'll give that one a dipped morsel
He'll point to that one at the table
He'll call that one by name

cards.question: Jesus dips the morsel and gives it to ___ son of Simon Iscariot.

cards.text: Judas takes the morsel, and Satan enters into him. Then Jesus tells Judas, "What you are about to do, do quickly."

cards.question: Jesus tells Judas to do quickly what he's about to do. Everyone else at the table knows why Jesus said it.

cards.text: Nobody at that table has a clue why Jesus said it. Here's a detail you'll want: Judas kept the money bag.

cards.question: Judas keeps the money bag. So what do some of the disciples think Jesus is telling him to do?

answers.text: Buy what's needed for the feast
Pay the owner of the house

cards.text: Some think he's off to buy what's needed for the feast, or to give something to the poor. Me? I'd have figured he was out for MORE chocolate chips.

cards.question: As soon as Judas receives the morsel, what does he do?

answers.text: He goes out into the night
He hands Jesus the money bag
He sits back down and stays quiet

cards.text: Judas is gone, out into the night. Once he's gone, Jesus speaks to the disciples still at the table. "Now the Son of Man is glorified, and God is glorified in Him."

cards.question: Jesus says God will glorify the Son, but not for a long time.

cards.text: Jesus says God will glorify Him at once. Then He calls them "Little children" and says He's with them only a little while longer.

cards.question: Jesus tells His disciples they'll look for Him. What does He say about where He's going?

answers.text: It's only a short walk away

cards.text: He said the same thing to the Jews, and now He says it to His disciples. Then Jesus gives them a new commandment.

cards.question: Jesus gives His disciples a new commandment. What is it?
Jesus says His disciples must love one another the same way He has ___ them.

cards.text: Then Jesus says everyone will be able to tell they're His disciples. Not by a matching apron. Not by a NAME TAG.

cards.question: How does Jesus say everyone will know they're His disciples?

cards.text: Love one another. THAT'S the name tag. But Simon Peter is still back on what Jesus said about going somewhere they can't come.

cards.question: Peter is still thinking about Jesus leaving. What does Peter ask Him?

answers.text: Lord when will You come back
Lord who will lead us now

cards.text: Jesus answers, "Where I am going, you cannot follow Me now, but you will follow later."

cards.question: Jesus tells Peter he'll follow later. Peter is happy to wait.

cards.text: LATER? Nope. Peter says, "Lord, why can't I follow You now?" and then he makes Jesus a big promise.

cards.question: Peter wants to follow Jesus now. What does Peter promise Him?

answers.text: To lay down his life for Him
To bring Judas back to Him

cards.text: Peter goes ALL IN, no pause, no fine print. Then Jesus answers with a question: "Will you lay down your life for Me?"

cards.question: Jesus says that before the rooster crows, Peter will ___ Him three times.

cards.text: Three times, before the rooster crows. We'll leave this table here for now, friend, but this night is NOT finished.

findings.problem: Stop 2 starts at John 13:30, but the passage's next stretch starts at John 13:31.

rule.text: Each stop covers the next stretch of the passage, in order, and gives its verse range.

findings.problem: Stop 2, card 14 quotes "Lord, why can't I follow You now?", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: This story card has four sentences: "Peter's not waiting around, and I respect it." / "Me?" / "I'd have just poked the guy with my mustache." / "So the disciple leans back..."

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The question asks how Jesus says He'll "show them," which makes all the disciples His audience. John 13:25-26 has Jesus answering the one disciple who asked.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

findings.problem: Judas first shows up here and on card 8, but no card says simply who he is, such as one of Jesus' disciples. Peter got an introduction on card 4. Judas never does.

rule.text: The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."
